canonical_project: Elsham Tech Park AI data centre campus (RAF Elsham Wolds)
owner: Elsham Tech Park Ltd / Greystoke Land

location.country: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland

notes: Outline planning approved by North Lincolnshire Council (11-12 Mar 2026) for GBP7.5bn campus at former RAF Elsham Wolds near Brigg: 15 data halls, >1.5m sqm, up to 1,000MW IT, on-site 49.9MW energy centre, BESS, district heating; construction expected 2027, first phase 2029. Planning ref PA/2025/643 per round-1.
